title.zh: 【Kalshi 与 BitGo 合作，支持机构客户以加密资产抵押借款作为永续合约保证金】
title.en: 【Kalshi 与 BitGo 合作，支持机构客户以加密资产抵押借款作为永续合约保证金】

current_state.zh: Kalshi Prime struck a tri-party collateral arrangement with BitGo Bank & Trust letting institutional clients borrow against custodied BTC, ETH and GENIUS Act-compliant stablecoins to margin futures positions on Kalshi, with loans issued by Kalshi Katalyst and more custodians to follow.
